entry_state: The insurance chapter preserves separate issued and held measurements, transition information, source populations and unresolved methods. Its finite examples specify obligations for implementation without claiming executed insurance readiness. Implementation contracts are next.
exit_state: Typed requests, layered results, immutable corrections and atomic durability requirements now preserve the earlier financial meanings. Plugin interfaces must expose material inputs and retain unknown solver regions. Human review and recovery are next.
findings: Python, SQLite and columnar files are explicitly convenience choices; committed accounting has one transactional owner.
Contextual identities, append-only assertions and candidate-set dependencies preserve conflicts and historical interpretations.
The unavailable probability mass remains in the result; interval104–116 requires the supplied bound and cannot be replaced by successful-path mean120.
Durability, migration and exact reruns are observable obligations, with runtime evidence still required.
